title: Mutation gate analysis for fixed candidate e319850 (incl. frozen-exam tests experiment)
runner: mutmut 3.3.1 + setproctitle shim (macOS fork fix) on disposable copies

testsets.combined: 174 candidate + 59 frozen exam tests (wired via frozen v1 tool's unused --tests arg; merged tests/helpers.py + conftest with hypothesis profile suppressing HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture; markers registered)

artifact_root_cause: mutmut 3.3.1 StatsCollector records the LAST pytest hook phase (teardown ~0.00s) for duration_by_test; all duration_by_test = 0.00s, so per-mutant CPU limit = ceil((0+1)*30 + process_time()) ~30-60s; frozen exam property/fuzz covering sets take ~110-240s => 442 spurious timeouts (not kills).

spot_checks.method: MUTANT_UNDER_TEST + PYTHONPATH=mutants/src + full covering set + --timeout=400 per test; activation validated against a known-killed mutant (37 failures)

estimate_basis: killed ~= 1654 + 79 former-killed re-kill = 1733; survived ~= 179 + 362 former-survivors = 541; score = 1733/2274 = 76.2%
uncertainty: plausible 73-77%; NEVER >=90%. Exhaustive classification of all 442 timeouts (~30-60 min compute) available if a tighter estimate is required.
equivalent_mutant_evidence: survivor profile from candidate-only run: ~30% equivalent (case-only SQL/string ~115, no-body-diff ~15); killable survivors: string constant 140, name 65, stmt add/remove 48, operator 25, number 23, other 6; parse_fail ~106
conclusion: The frozen mutation gate (>=90%) is NOT satisfied by fixed candidate e319850 under any measured test set. Including the frozen exam's 59 tests kills ~2 additional former survivors and re-kills former-killed mutants, but does not lift the score over 90%: equivalent mutants alone exceed the <=227 survivor budget. The apparent 90.23% is a mutmut 3.3.1 timeout artifact.
historical_contrast: pre-fix base ac283d71 measured 93.02% (1707 killed / 128 survived, FAILURE-LEDGER entry 26). The e319850 fix that passes the frozen exam changed the mutant landscape and dropped the honest score below threshold.
decision: HUMAN AUTHORIZED: RECORD FAIL AND PAUSE FINALIZATION. v0.1.0 acceptance sequence paused at the MUTATION gate.
